items.title: 'The party had to end': Young investors torn on budget tax reform
items.description: Some young Australians locked out of the property market due to unaffordable housing have pursued ETFs and "rentvesting" as a way to build financial security. Here's what they make of the budget's CGT reforms.

items.title: Tax breaks reward those who can afford to take risks. What about the rest of us?
items.description: As the federal budget prompts howls of protest from those who earn the bulk of their income from owning assets rather than working, we shouldn't forget the relative privilege that has allowed many of those people to take those risks.

items.title: Father faces court after allegedly murdering wife and two sons
items.description: The 47-year-old has faced court charged with what police described as the "particularly violent" murder of his wife and sons in Sydney's south-west.

items.title: Australia's worst diphtheria outbreak 'for decades' spreads to WA, Qld and SA
items.description: An ongoing diphtheria outbreak in the Northern Territory has now spread across its borders to Western Australia, Queensland and South Australia, with Health Minister Mark Butler describing it as the nation's worst "for decades".

items.title: Israeli forces have detained 11 Australians after intercepting Gaza-bound flotilla
items.description: Israeli forces detain 11 Australians after its navy intercepts ships seeking to break Israel's maritime blockade of Gaza, flotilla organisers say.

items.title: Stranded driver, students among 10 rescues during heavy rainfall in NSW and Qld
items.description: Almost 50 high school students and teachers have been rescued after becoming stranded by floodwater at a national park in the Scenic Rim while on a school camp. Earlier, near the New South Wales and Queensland border, crews worked to rescue a person stuck in a vehicle at Numinbah Valley near Murwillumbah. NSW SES volunteers and emergency service partners have responded to 197 incidents since Monday afternoon.

items.title: Apology given for 'appalling' display of autopsy body parts without consent
items.description: A formal apology has been given in Tasmania's parliament for the past practice of taking human specimens from autopsies and displaying them in a museum without the knowledge of family members.

items.title: Live: More jet fuel secured from China, Albanese says
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese announces the federal government has secured 600,000 barrels of jet fuel from China. Follow live.

items.title: How to spot the 'psychosis' red flags in an 'AI relationship'
items.description: Intensive chatbot use may be amplifying dangerous and harmful delusions for some users. Here are some of the "red flags" for "AI psychosis".

items.title: Xi to welcome Putin for visit days after hosting Trump
items.description: While this meeting comes just days after Beijing hosted the US president, the Kremlin insists there is "no correlation" between the visits.

items.title: Shooters kill three people at San Diego mosque in suspected hate crime
items.description: Two teenage gunmen opened fire at San Diego's largest mosque, killing three men, before later being found dead, police say.

items.title: What Kylie Minogue learned from Michael Hutchence and Nick Cave
items.description: Australia's reigning Queen of Pop discusses her relationships with Nick Cave and the late Michael Hutchence, and being tapped to headline the AFL grand final's pre-game entertainment.

items.title: Ebola treatment centres open in Congo as WHO sends team
items.description: The cash-strapped World Health Organization is sending a team of experts to the Democratic Republic of the Congo as hundreds of cases of Ebola are suspected.

items.title: Live: ASX jumps more than 1 per cent in rebound rally
items.description: The local share market is rebounding from Monday's heavy selling, as shares in Tuas make back some of their heavy losses. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: 'Nowhere for me to exist': Growing up as a biracial child
items.description: KA was "stripped" of her culture as a child and has been on a journey to reclaim her connection to her Filipino heritage.

items.title: Money stress causing tension in your relationship? This might help
items.description: While financial tension between partners isn't always about money, many people clash over values, spending habits and how they respond to financial pressure.

items.title: Two German film students track down their stolen movie in new doco
items.description: What do you do when your stolen film wins a slew of awards for the thief? In the case of these filmmakers, you travel across the globe to hunt him down.

items.title: Road with no name leads emergency crews astray
items.description: When Chris Stehbens spied a lost ambulance driving up and down his road during a Triple Zero (000) emergency response, he was not surprised by the struggle to find the right address.

items.title: Hawthorn 'extremely disappointed' by AFL's call to end Tasmanian partnership
items.description: Hawthorn is less than pleased after being forced to cease playing home games in Tasmania ahead of the Devils' AFL entry.

items.title: No long-term rentals but 200 short-stay listings in WA towns
items.description: There are renewed calls for a ban on short-stay rentals as a new report shows holiday homes vastly outnumber permanent rentals in small regional communities.

items.title: 'I wish I were dead': The heartbreaking toll of Australia's favourite pastime
items.description: Australians are the world's biggest gamblers, losing billions every year. But the true cost goes far beyond the financial.

items.title: Neymar recalled for Brazil's World Cup campaign despite three-year hiatus
items.description: Carlo Ancelotti includes Brazil's all-time leading goalscorer in his first FIFA World Cup squad.

items.title: The dead fish waste disaster that Tasmania failed to plan for
items.description: High-volume salmon mortalities last year swamped Tasmania's waste streams as companies scrambled to find somewhere to accept them, documents show. There are now concerns the state remains unprepared for future mass deaths.

items.title: Trump says he has postponed a planned new strike on Iran
items.description: US President Donald Trump says an attack on Iran that was "scheduled for tomorrow" has been postponed at the request of Gulf state leaders.

items.title: Police union pushes for US-style night court to free up holding cells
items.description: The NSW Police Association makes its case for night courts at its biennial conference in Wollongong.
